# KSOU Online — Karnataka State Open University

> Karnataka State Open University (KSOU) is a government university established in 1996, headquartered in Mysuru, Karnataka, India. KSOU Online is the university's official online learning division offering UGC-approved, NAAC A+ rated online degree programmes for students and working professionals across India.

## About

KSOU Online provides flexible, affordable higher education through its online learning platform. The university is approved by UGC (University Grants Commission), recognized by AICTE (All India Council for Technical Education), and holds NAAC A+ accreditation with a GPA of 3.31. Over 115,000 students have graduated from KSOU since its establishment.

## Online Programmes Offered

### Undergraduate (UG)
- **BA (Bachelor of Arts)** — 3-year programme, ₹10,000/year, ₹30,000 total
- **B.Com (Bachelor of Commerce)** — 3-year programme, ₹12,000/year, ₹36,000 total

### Postgraduate (PG)
- **MBA (Master of Business Administration)** — 2-year programme, ₹40,000/year, ₹80,000 total
- **M.Com (Master of Commerce)** — 2-year programme, ₹20,000/year, ₹40,000 total
- **MA (Master of Arts)** — 2-year programme, ₹15,000/year, ₹30,000 total, specializations in Kannada, English, Hindi, Sanskrit, Economics
- **M.Sc Mathematics** — 2-year programme, ₹40,000/year, ₹80,000 total

Examination fees are charged separately from the programme fee.

## Key Facts
- Government university (not private)
- UGC-entitled online programmes under the UGC ODL & OL Regulations, 2020
- NAAC A+ Accredited (GPA 3.31), valid five years from May 19, 2023
- Ranked 2nd in the Open University category, NIRF 2025 (Ministry of Education)
- AICTE Recognized (for MBA)
- 115,000+ graduates since 1996
- 120+ programmes across disciplines
- Admissions open for July 2026 cycle
- Admission requires an ABC ID (created via DigiLocker) and a DEB ID (created from the ABC ID at deb.ugc.ac.in/StudentDEBId), as UGC mandates for all online and distance programmes
